description: Minimal debug scenario - 1 Alpine VM on an isolated subnet (192.168.147.0/24). Used to quickly verify the full deploy pipeline (clone, cloud-init, ssh reachability, proxy-jump) without spinning up a full lab. dsa-vm-01 hostname (VMID 8001, IP 192.168.147.250) on vmbr147 ; built from alpine-nano template (VMID 9903). Optional admin-wazuh VM (VMID 8050, IP 192.168.142.150, vmbr142, gated by INSTALL_WAZUH, default off) deploys a Wazuh SIEM server + agent on dsa-vm-01. Optional admin-misp VM (VMID 8051, IP 192.168.142.151, vmbr142, gated by INSTALL_MISP, default off) deploys the MISP threat intel docker-compose stack from range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/misp-standalone/. Both admin VMs use the medium template (VMID 9232, 2cpu/8gb/64gb, built on first WAZUH/MISP-enabled deploy).
